title: The Ramsey recursion inequality
statement:
For integers $k \ge 2$ and $l \ge 2$, the Ramsey numbers satisfy
\[
r(k, l) \le r(k, l-1) + r(k-1, l),
\]
where $r(k, l)$ denotes the least number of vertices $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique on $k$ vertices or an independent set on $l$ vertices.
replaced:
For any two integers $k \geq 2$ and $l \geq 2$
\[r(k, l) \leq r(k, l-1) + r(k-1, l) \qquad (7.7)\]
Furthermore, if $r(k, l-1)$ and $r(k-1, l)$ are both even, then strict
inequality holds in (7.7).
